status: Implemented; recorded focused/client evidence retained and final full/native regressions passed. See the stated verification scope.
transport: Original TCP MQTT 3.1.1 QoS0 topics and optional username/password. Disabled by default. Explicit config/eln-mqtt.json endpoints; /eln mqtt reload operator command. Bounded asynchronous packet/command queues, bounded payloads, partial-read handling and reconnect; I/O threads cannot access the Minecraft world. Credentials stay in endpoint file and are never synchronized to items or clients.
meter: Original 0.0125-ohm switched shunt, voltage AND current cables, initially on, signed I*abs(input voltage), energy/time reset, original wheels/model and secure name/server/units controls. MQTT stat/energy preserves original wire value in kJ; original field name energyWh was misleading. Stat/time converts the original 72x meter time to elapsed seconds.
controller: Four independent 0.05-ohm signal gates, initially disabled/high impedance, original A-right/B-back/C-left/D-front mapping, read versus write, normalized and volts commands, finite clamped outputs, real loaded voltages and saved modes. Six-digit unique device IDs persist across reload; duplicates reallocate IDs.
lifecycle: Bound by actual node and part identity; removal, reload and unticking/unloaded chunks cannot retain valid callbacks. Actual socket broker test drives real loads, rejects NaN/Infinity, opens and closes the real meter, resets counters, rejects stale replacement callbacks and confirms reconnect subscriptions plus retained metadata.
scope: Source TCP transport only. Does not claim TLS/WebSocket or QoS1/2 support absent from original implementation.

fullRegression.result: All passed. Includes original MQTT meter, four-port controller, actual socket broker commands and reconnect. Modbus and resource/recipe completion were installed after this JVM started and are not covered by this result.

finalRegression.scope: All required cases passed. Existing per-device focused/client evidence and its limits remain authoritative; this field does not claim every configuration was exercised.

historicalCheckpointStatus: Original meter/controller, actual loopback transport and broker, focused Minecraft and client verified. Full 262-case regression running.
